canonical.claim: There is one canonical residue r in [0,p), with p equal to the LCM of the moduli. Every integer solution is exactly r + k·p, for an integer k.
canonical.conditions: Mathematical theorem: positive moduli and pairwise compatibility. The executable additionally requires normalized residues and a period that fits i64.
canonical.key: After processing a prefix, (r,p) represents all its solutions and p ≤ MAX. The exact predicate is fold_inv in the Statement tab.

statement.label: Complete representation
statement.text:
Definition Rep (C : list constraint) (r p : Z) : Prop :=
  p = L C /\ 0 <= r < p /\ forall x, Sol C x <-> congruent p x r.

statement.label: Rocq statement
statement.text:
Definition T_finite_canonical : Prop := forall C, positive C -> Pairwise C ->
  exists r, Rep C r (L C) /\ forall s, Rep C s (L C) -> s=r.

statement.label: Rocq statement
statement.text:
Definition T_finite_all_solutions : Prop := forall C r p, Rep C r p ->
  forall x, Sol C x <-> exists k, x=r+k*p.

statement.label: Exact mathematical loop invariant
statement.text: Definition fold_inv (done : list constraint) (r p : Z) : Prop := Rep done r p /\ p <= MAX.

proof.label: Rocq theorem and proof
proof.text:
Theorem finite_canonical_proved : T_finite_canonical.
Proof.
  intros C HC Hpair. destruct (proj2 (finite_existence_proved C HC) Hpair) as [x Hx].
  exists (x mod L C). pose proof (representation_from_solution C x HC Hx) as Hrep.
  split; [assumption|]. intros s Hs. exact (proj1 (Rep_unique _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hrep)).
Qed.

proof.label: Rocq theorem and proof
proof.text:
Theorem finite_all_solutions_proved : T_finite_all_solutions.
Proof.
  intros C r p (_ & _ & Hrep) x. rewrite Hrep. unfold congruent.
  split; intros [k Hk]; exists k; lia.
Qed.

inference.label: Inference implementation

steps: Pairwise compatibility supplies an integer solution (finite_existence_proved).
Reduce that solution modulo the LCM to obtain the canonical representative. Rep_unique establishes uniqueness in the canonical interval.
Rep already characterizes the whole solution set. Unfolding congruence and integer arithmetic yields x = r + k·p.
The fold starts at the empty summary (0,1). Each successful merge preserves the prefix representation; the operational batch proofs connect these steps to the emitted Wasm.

overflow.claim: Overflow occurs exactly for a valid, compatible system whose mathematical LCM exceeds MAX = 9223372036854775807.
overflow.conditions: Invalid inputs and incompatibility are classified before the fold. The multiplication guard assumes positive moduli bounded by MAX.
overflow.key: factor = L / gcd(L,m). If factor > MAX / m, report overflow before multiplying. Otherwise factor·m is representable.

statement.label: Exact guard equivalence and product safety
statement.text:
Definition T_lcm_guard : Prop := forall m n, moduli m n ->
  ((m / Z.gcd m n > MAX / n) <-> MAX < Z.lcm m n) /\
  (m / Z.gcd m n <= MAX / n -> word ((m / Z.gcd m n)*n)).

statement.label: Exact finite-system overflow classification
statement.text:
Definition T_overflow_exact : Prop := forall C,
  system_model C = Overflow <-> valid C /\ Pairwise C /\ MAX < L C.

proof.label: Rocq theorem and proof
proof.text:
Theorem lcm_guard_proved : T_lcm_guard.
Proof.
  intros m n Hdom. destruct Hdom as (Hm & Hn).
  destruct (reduction_proved m n ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia)) as
    (Hg & Hgm & Hgn & Hm1 & Hn1 & Hcop & Hl & Hp).
  rewrite <- Hl. unfold period. split.
  - pose proof (Z.div_mod MAX n ltac:(lia)).
    pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound MAX n ltac:(lia)). split; nia.
  - intros Hguard. apply nonnegative_word. split; [nia|].
    pose proof (Z.div_mod MAX n ltac:(lia)).
    pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound MAX n ltac:(lia)). nia.
Qed.

proof.label: Rocq theorem and proof
proof.text:
Theorem overflow_exact_proved : T_overflow_exact.
Proof.
  intros C. split.
  - intros H. pose proof (finite_model_proved C). rewrite H in H0. exact H0.
  - intros H. apply result_post_unique with (C:=C); [apply finite_model_proved|exact H].
Qed.

inference.label: Inference implementation

steps: Use the GCD/LCM identity to express the next period as (L / gcd(L,m))·m.
Euclidean division of MAX by positive m proves that comparing against MAX / m is equivalent to checking the product, without forming an overflowing product.
finite_model_proved establishes the complete result classification. The forward direction extracts the overflow conditions; uniqueness of result_post proves the reverse.
Pairwise compatibility is checked first, so a contradiction is not hidden by an overflowing prefix.

permutation.claim: Reordering the congruences preserves the entire result, including invalidity, incompatibility, overflow, canonical residue, and period.
permutation.conditions: The two lists are permutations. For the Wasm theorem, both invocations use the same signed i32 count and satisfy the input-memory premises.
permutation.key: A permutation preserves validity, the solution set, and the LCM. result_post uniquely determines the result.

statement.label: Rocq statement
statement.text:
Definition T_permutation : Prop := forall A B,
  Permutation A B -> system_model A = system_model B.

proof.label: Rocq theorem and proof
proof.text:
Theorem permutation_proved : T_permutation.
Proof.
  intros A B HP. apply result_post_unique with (C:=B).
  - eapply result_post_permutation; [exact HP|apply finite_model_proved].
  - apply finite_model_proved.
Qed.

proof.label: Transfer to actual Wasm execution
proof.text:
Theorem system_batch_permutation memA memB hsA hsB ptrRA ptrMA ptrRB ptrMB c rsA msA rsB msB rA pA rB pB :
 system_input_memory memA ptrRA ptrMA rsA msA -> batch_word32 c -> system_input_memory memB ptrRB ptrMB rsB msB -> batch_word32 c ->
 Permutation (be_active c rsA msA) (be_active c rsB msB) ->
 system_run memA hsA 8%num (be_args ptrRA ptrMA c) rA -> system_run memA hsA 9%num (be_args ptrRA ptrMA c) pA ->
 system_run memB hsB 8%num (be_args ptrRB ptrMB c) rB -> system_run memB hsB 9%num (be_args ptrRB ptrMB c) pB ->
 rA=rB /\ pA=pB.
Proof. move=> HA WA HB WB. exact: (be_execution_permutation (system_batch_refines hsA HA WA) (system_batch_refines hsB HB WB)). Qed.

inference.label: Inference implementation

steps: finite_model_proved gives a result satisfying result_post for each list.
Transfer the first result to the permuted list using result_post_permutation.
result_post_unique forces the two model results to agree.
system_batch_refines connects actual Wasm invocations to that model; system_batch_permutation concludes equality of both returned fields.

execution.claim: The actual batch Wasm export has a terminating, nontrapping normal execution, and every normal result agrees with the proved finite-system model.
execution.conditions: A signed i32 count and correctly represented arrays in prepared memory. Counts outside 0…16 return invalid; the finite-list result_post is stated for counts in 0…16.
execution.key: Two complete readable 128-byte array regions, with no 32-bit pointer wrap. Index bounds, calls, arithmetic guards, and loops are included in the proof.

statement.label: Public execution theorem statement
statement.text:
Theorem system_batch_solve_execution mem hs rb mb c rs ms :
 system_input_memory mem rb mb rs ms -> batch_word32 c ->
 total_correct (system_run mem hs 8%num (be_args rb mb c))
 (fun r => r=solve_value (be_batch_result c rs ms) /\ (0<=c<=16 -> result_post (be_active c rs ms) (be_batch_result c rs ms))).

statement.label: Array representation
statement.text:
Definition array_region (m : meminst) (base : N) (xs : seq i64) : Prop :=
  size xs = 16%nat /\ (base + 128 <= operations.mem_length m)%num /\
  (base + 128 <= 4294967296)%num /\ array_cells m base xs.

statement.label: Public memory premise
statement.text:
Definition system_input_memory m residues_ptr moduli_ptr residues moduli : Prop :=
  system_memory_valid m /\ array_region m residues_ptr residues /\
  array_region m moduli_ptr moduli.

proof.label: Rocq theorem and proof
proof.text:
Theorem system_batch_solve_execution mem hs rb mb c rs ms :
 system_input_memory mem rb mb rs ms -> batch_word32 c ->
 total_correct (system_run mem hs 8%num (be_args rb mb c))
 (fun r => r=solve_value (be_batch_result c rs ms) /\ (0<=c<=16 -> result_post (be_active c rs ms) (be_batch_result c rs ms))).
Proof.
 move=> Hmem Wc. apply: (system_run_total_correct (result:=solve_value (be_batch_result c rs ms))); first exact: (system_batch_solve_exec_exists hs Hmem Wc).
 split; first reflexivity. exact: batch_result_post.
Qed.

inference.label: Inference implementation

steps: system_batch_solve_exec_exists constructs a normal execution of the actual generated function.
system_run_total_correct combines this witness with uniqueness of normal results for the read-only Wasm subset.
batch_result_post supplies the mathematical meaning of the returned classification.
This is not a claim that every possible operational reduction schedule terminates. The browser displays the recorded proof; it does not run Rocq.
